enable: Upload each scheduled backup to this destination
configure: Choose a backup destination to enable scheduled encrypted uploads.
changed: The selected destination changed or was disabled. Scheduled uploads are paused until you explicitly select the current destination and save. Local backups continue.
help: Uploads run in a background job after local verification. Local retention still applies if uploading fails; the newly created pair is protected. The next due backup tries uploading again. No cloud objects are deleted. Provider acknowledgement is not a read-back or restore test.
warning: Local backup verified; remote upload or its receipt needs attention. The new local pair was kept and configured local retention still applies. Check the destination and latest upload receipt.
invalid_destination: The backup destination changed or is unavailable. Reload, select the current backup destination and save again.
storage_help: Create encrypted backups manually, or explicitly enable scheduled uploads on Backups. Backup objects are never served as website media.
lease_warning: Local backup verified, but the data-directory lease could not be renewed. Cleanup was skipped to avoid overlapping another operation. Check the current update/restore operation.
uploaded_unrecorded: Both files were acknowledged by the provider, but the local receipt could not be saved. Review this upload before relying on it for recovery.
paused: Scheduled upload paused: select the active backup destination again. Local backups and configured retention continue.
